title: thymus serpyllum f. vallesiacus
intro: Thymus serpyllum f. vallesiacus, commonly known as wild thyme, is a fragrant, low-growing perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. Its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of wild thyme include expectorant, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating a range of conditions, including sore throats and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of wild thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic benefits.
